resources.string: On your Lectern, open Settings → Devices and show a pairing QR code: either \"Pair a phone over the relay\" (end-to-end encrypted, works from anywhere) or \"Pair a phone\" (direct). Scan it here, or paste its link. You can also paste your Lectern\'s address if this phone reaches it over Tailscale.
That is not a Lectern pairing link or address.
